title: DISC V2 Situational Forced-Choice Instrument
purpose: Replace the legacy Likert-by-dimension DISC item structure with situational forced-choice items whose four plausible responses map item-specifically to D/I/S/C.

measurement.construct: Behavioral response tendencies associated with Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness.
measurement.intendedUse: Descriptive behavioral profile for self-understanding and development.

blueprint.note: Target coverage is a content blueprint; every item presents one option for each DISC dimension and every response contributes to exactly one dimension.

measurement.scoring: Ipsative forced-choice count. Each selected option is mapped through the item-specific scoringKey to one DISC dimension. Dimension score = selected choices / 24 × 100.
measurement.overallRule: No substantive overall DISC score. The legacy generic overallScore field is retained only as a compatibility envelope and must not be presented as an overall ability score.
measurement.tieRule: If primary or secondary dimensions tie, D/I/S/C canonical order is used only as a deterministic display tie-breaker; the underlying dimension scores remain unchanged.
measurement.normalization: Dimension scores are percentages of forced choices and are ipsative: their four percentages sum to 100.
measurement.missingResponse: Assessment submission requires all 24 responses; partial scoring is not accepted by the V2 runtime.

implementationBoundaries.questionIdentity: New V2 logical question identities are additive; historical V1 QuestionVersions remain immutable.
implementationBoundaries.positionMapping: Option position must never globally imply D/I/S/C. Each V2 item carries an item-specific permutation.
implementationBoundaries.customerExposure: scoringKey and dimension mapping metadata must never be returned by customer runtime.
implementationBoundaries.database: Additive taxonomy lifecycle migration only; no schema mutation and no destructive table operation.
